title: Scale the same lottery
hook: Two stated cases: explore stakes relative to fixed wealth.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How stakes relative to fixed wealth affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Change, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare stakes relative to fixed wealth in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: A toy log-utility agent has wealth 10000, gains 100 with probability 0.5 and otherwise loses 80. What is expected log utility minus log current wealth?
